meta.description: Military rules (GDD section 8): units, recruitment, bases, reserves, movement and combat. Game-design defaults to be tuned in Phase 13 (balance).

units.comment: Strength per soldier. Reservists only defend; trainees defend their own city.

upkeep.comment: Weekly cost per soldier is calibrated per country so that its starting army costs its real military spending (SIPRI). Reservists cost a share of that.

recruitment.comment: Manpower per city is a share of its population and refills slowly. Bases raise how many soldiers a city can recruit per turn.

bases.comment: Levels 1-3. Each finished military base investment in a city raises its level by one. Starting bases: the capital and the largest cities of countries with an army.

reserves.comment: Mandatory service fills the reserve pool; without it reserves shrink. Starting reserves are a multiple of the regular army.

army.comment: Starting regulars are split between the capital province and the most populous other provinces. A country already at war first puts frontShareAtWar of them on its front provinces.

naval.comment: Armies cross the sea between port cities; a crossing takes one turn per kmPerTurn of sea. A convoy sailing to enemy land loses interceptBase of its soldiers per turn at sea, plus interceptAirDefense times the interception rate of enemy air defense covering the landing city (GDD section 8: a crossing can be intercepted).

rebels.comment: Rebels raise fighters from the population of the land they hold; more while national support is low, deserters when it recovers.
